text: Follow-up implementation pointers verified at2753627d (no implementation in board-review tranche): StudioLayouts.compareSummary defines pane compare.participants, but StudioWindow summary host map mounts participant plot/table, queries and items without any compare.participants node; StudioPanes therefore supplies its generic placeholder. CompareSummaryVM.participantTable already uses exact overall/grouped report participants and served accounting; retain each served participant.ref rather than reconstructing refs from labels. Provenance.children has StudyNavigator.participants(ReportRef.Cell, PageRequest), including reporting spec/scale/group scope. Reuse that identity seam and the existing navigator composite-keyboard/selection pattern, not a desktop calculation of means or grouping. Portable tests should cover run/reporting/scale/group changes and late reads, exact refs/activation, missing/refused data and paging/filtering if present. Native checks should mount the actual Results navigator in t3, show24fixtureparticipants with declared cell/scale, exercise one Tab stop/arrows/Enter and verify accessible names. Keep Remembered-only board examples distinct from overall participant values. Update the existing explicit Results-board deviation only when the feature is qualified and landed.
